dedupe_keys.name: rediam wms equipamientos contra incendios en andalucia 2011

description: REDIAM. WMS Equipamientos contra incendios en Andalucía, 2011 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by juntadeandalucia.es. WMS service corresponding to the location at detail scale of the set of facilities that constitute the basic infrastructure of the INFOCA Plan in Andalusia (2011). It is constituted in two coverages. One of CEDEFOS, BRICA, Landing Tracks and Auxiliary Bases and another coverage of Fixed Surveillance Points. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "REDIAM. WMS Fire equipment in Andalucia, 2011" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include incendios forestales, Andalucía, prevención de fuegos forestales, infraestructuras detección, IDEAndalucia, REDIAM. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2014-08-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
